li.label: kept apart like children
li.description: The council split up our work and our rooms so we'd stay apart. My half of the colony is smaller.

li.label: my shifts were reshuffled
li.description: My shifts got moved around because of somebody else's quarrel. I wasn't even asked.

li.label: lessons from my rival
li.description: I've been stuck taking lessons from my rival. I learned a few things, and I'll never admit it.

li.label: living in someone else's feud
li.description: Those two glare at each other through every meal. I just want to eat my soup without picking a side.

li.label: working alongside my friend
li.description: I work the same shift as my friend now. The days go much faster.

li.label: night watch with a friend
li.description: We stood night watch together. It was cold and dark and nothing happened, and we talked for hours.

li.label: posted apart from my friend
li.description: I asked to work beside my friend, and the council decided the turnips need me more.

li.label: the council plays favorites
li.description: Some people ask and get, because they have the right friends. The rest of us just work.

li.label: my friend moved on
li.description: We used to do everything together. Now they spend their evenings with other people.

li.label: the council meddled in my friendships
li.description: Now the council has opinions about who I spend my evenings with. That's none of their business.

li.label: made welcome
li.description: They made room for me at their table and passed me the bread first.

li.label: pushed into our evenings
li.description: Our evenings come with an extra person now, by the council's arrangement. It's not the same.

li.label: walked away clean
li.description: I lied to cover for my friend, and now they're the one being punished. I got off clean, and I feel awful.

li.label: my friend took my punishment
li.description: It was my mistake, but my friend is the one being punished for it. I can't look them in the eye.

li.label: friends covering for friends
li.description: One of them lied to cover for a friend, and the council let the liar off.

li.label: my plea was heard
li.description: I begged the council to go easy on my friend, and they listened.

li.label: my plea fell flat
li.description: I swallowed my pride and begged for my friend. They heard me out, then did it anyway.

li.label: begged for me and made it worse
li.description: I never asked them to speak for me, and their begging only made my punishment worse.

li.label: the remembrance night
li.description: We told the story of the fight from start to end and drank to all who bled for this place. I slept well that night.

li.label: told the story of the fight together
li.description: We told the story of the fight together, the way it really happened. They know what that day was like.

li.label: an hour for the fight
li.description: An hour of speeches after dinner, then back to work. The fight deserved more than that.

li.label: the fight forgotten
li.description: We bled for this place, and the council can't spare one evening to remember it.

li.label: my things were searched
li.description: They turned out everything I own on my rival's word, right down to my socks, and found nothing.

li.label: punished on a rival's word
li.description: There was no proof, just my rival's word against mine, and the council believed them.

li.label: a friend punished without proof
li.description: A friend of mine was punished on a rival's word, with no proof at all.

li.label: made to take it back
li.description: I had to take back what I said, with the others watching. I know I was right.

li.label: a seat by order
li.description: They let me sit with them only because the council told them to. The talk stops whenever I sit down.

li.label: hosted the whole colony
li.description: I put on a supper for the colony, and people came, even a few I didn't expect.

li.label: an empty table
li.description: I set a table for the colony, and half the chairs stayed empty. I know exactly who didn't come.

li.label: credited for my work
li.description: They said the work was mine, for all to hear. It was, but it's nice to hear it said.

li.label: my work went to my rival
li.description: I built it, but the council gave my rival the credit. I want to knock it down every time I walk past.

li.label: no credit for my work
li.description: The council called it colony work and didn't name anyone. I'll remember that next time there's colony work to do.

li.label: counted like a thief
li.description: Every sack in the stores got counted twice on my rival's word, as if I were a thief. It all added up.

li.label: lost my little perks
li.description: We used to get a bit extra on our plates and the warmer coats. The council has put an end to that.

li.label: watched at my own job
li.description: My rival stands at my shoulder now and writes down every ration I hand out.

li.label: drew a bad lot
li.description: The good things are handed out by lot now. I drew the patched coat and the burnt end of the stew.
